cap: Four benign conditions mimic infection or cancer and are told apart by setting and histology. Lactational mastitis follows a cracked nipple, periductal mastitis follows smoking-driven squamous metaplasia and keratin plugging, duct ectasia is dilated ducts in older women, and fat necrosis follows trauma and calcium soaps. Implants add contracture, silicone granuloma and a rare lymphoma.
